watches.name: Atlantis Blackfish Automatic Dive Watch
watches.description: Our upgraded Atlantis Blackfish watch includes a Swiss Automatic movement, so that you'll never need a battery again. Automatic movements take advantage of your hand and wrist motion to supply energy to the watch. It's technically better than a Quartz watch, but still the same accurate timekeeping. This premium dive watch is carved from a solid block of 316-L stainless steel with Swiss automatic movement, a uni-directional bezel with our custom-designed ratcheting system and lumed numbering against a stylish Blackfish scale dial. The watch features just the right amount of illumination for tactical situations. It will not give your location away. The sleek black rubber strap sits comfortably on your wrist, giving you unrivaled versatility and durability. The Blackfish watch has a dark, powerful presence that implies strength. And it lives up to that promise. We include the little details that keep the watch scratch free, unbroken and looking new for a very long time. Our Atlantis Blackfish Quartz Dive Watch is a more affordable version of this watch, which uses a quartz movement.

watches.name: Draper Quartz Men's Watch
watches.description: Our Draper men's watch features casual styling, but with the toughness you expect from Smith & Bradley. Swiss 515 movement means it will never lose time. And the stainless steel construction with an anti-reflective sapphire crystal face is built to handle daily wear. This watch looks great, and it's backed by our Limited Lifetime Warranty because it's made to weather the storm. Get a modern take on the classic men's watch. Italian leather watch band and 20 ATM water resistance. Our masterpiece for the workplace, whether you're working from home or the construction site.

watches.name: Automatic Full Service
watches.description: A full overhaul for Smith & Bradley automatic watches, done in-house by the people who build them. Movement disassembled, cleaned, oiled and reassembled Timing regulated and adjusted Winding and power reserve tested All seals replaced: stem, crown and case back Water pressure test to the watch's rated depth Case and bracelet cleaned and inspected Any additional parts beyond seals are quoted after inspection, before we do the work. We recommend an overhaul every five years. Turnaround is up to 15 business days from when we receive your watch. See our Watch Service & Repair page for the full service menu and how to send your watch in.

watches.name: Springfield GMT Field Watch
watches.description: The Springfield GMT is our upgraded classic American field watch with a GMT addition. Similar to the watches that have donned the wrists of men for almost 100 years and inspired by the watch issued to US Infantry during World War II, the Springfield GMT is a tribute to the heroes of our times.

watches.name: Discovery Field Watch
watches.description: We spent years creating a classic field watch with a Swiss Quartz movement, tough stainless steel casing and a perfect NATO watch strap. This watch will never let you down no matter how far you wander. Special features: 40mm watch is small and light, won't disturb your day. Swiss quartz movement for reliable, accurate timekeeping. 5ATM/50m water resistant watch is suitable for swimming, surfing. Tough mineral glass front is clear. Includes military time/24-hour timing. 20mm NATO watch strap included. Arrives in a handsome field watch case.

watches.name: SOCN Blackfish Watch Gift Set
watches.description: Have you found your tribe? This is a special version of our Atlantis Blackfish Quartz watch featuring the Find Your Tribe logo and a illuminated bezel. Just like the Warriors that SOCN supports, it is designed and built in the U.S. This all black watch is a combination of tactical watch and dive watch, which is waterproof to 300 meters. Great watches are made for great men. Gift set includes the special edition Find Your Tribe Quartz watch in a waterproof dive watch case with a black NATO watch strap. Customers who order the metal bracelet will also receive the NATO watch strap in their order. Every purchase supports the SOCN Network to help men Find their Tribe.

watches.name: Enchanted Women's Watch
watches.description: Something a little different for Smith & Bradley. We created a women's watch that looks delicate, but is as tough as our men's watches. Featuring a mother-of-pearl dial, AAA cubic zirconia stones, and a handsome leather watch band, the 39mm Enchanted women's watch is a stand-out timepiece in more ways than one. The 316L stainless steel case features a fixed bezel with AAA cubic zirconia stones, and the look is complemented with a mother of pearl face. Sporty but refined, the Enchanted watch design is timeless. And yet, we used our experience in creating tough, indestructible men's watches to make sure this one wouldn't crack either. It's tough. And beautiful. Watch Specifications Dial: Mother of Pearl with AAA CZ Stones Movement: Miyota 2035 Quartz Case Material: Polished 316L Stainless Steel Case Diameter: 39mm Leather watch band width: 18mm Water Resistance: 10ATM Gemstones: AAA Cubic Zirconia

watches.name: Atlantis Sport Blue Dive Watch
watches.description: Dive deep into the unknown with this handsome blue diving watch. And don't stop. This rugged men's watch can handle up to 300 meters of ocean depth without a problem. Yet it's stylish enough to impress your friends every time you wear it. Carved from a solid block of 316-L stainless steel, this blue watch is assembled in the USA with a quality Swiss quartz movement. It keeps perfect time all the time. The watch also features a uni-directional bezel with our custom-designed ratcheting system. The watch face has a lumed numbering against an ocean wave styled blue dial. It makes a very handsome timepiece. At Smith & Bradley, we believe in the little details. Like a stainless steel back. And a custom blue rubber watch strap that perfectly matches the blue dial and face of this men's watch. We designed this to last forever. It's not a trifle to be thrown away in a year's time. We wanted to create a watch that can handle whatever you decide to do today. From scuba diving to surfing to interviewing candidates. It's guaranteed to catch eyes, impress your companions and handle whatever you throw at it. The anti-reflective sapphire crystal cover is virtually indestructible. Like everything we make at Smith & Bradley. This is the better men's watch you've been looking for.

It makes ZERO difference whether you’re hitting the mountains, in the boardroom, or simply relaxing with your loved ones— this watch has the powerful presence that exudes the fearless and daring man you are.
